### DJ Quincy & DJ Row-Z @ NCF Cultural Co-op, Ballina

![Quincy](space/quincy.jpg)

**Saturday July 19th** /
**Start: 9pm**

Cormac Quinn and Ronan O'Reilly will play a DJ set with a mix of house and techno genres, incorporating some live instrumentation into the DJ set.

**All funds go to water projects in Gaza** (thanks to Derek Greham representing Irish in Gaza group).
